subject: Export Certification Accelerator: DPA redlines & evidence sprint
messages:
From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@aureliahealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com; kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@aureliahealth.com; data-procurement@aureliahealth.com
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redlines + routing evidence for EU processing

Hi Stephanie / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're close on commercial terms, but legal has pushed back on a few DPA items and needs a compact bundle of evidence to complete the export certification for our EU sites. Attached is a redline (v2) and a short list of downstream questions:

- Can you confirm which subprocessor tiers process EU customer data and where the data egress occurs (region + provider)?
- We need a TIA/DTIA mapping that shows safeguards for onshore caching fallback and cross-border processor hops.
- Legal asked for a statement on the UK addendum applicability (if customers choose UK residency).

Would it be possible to get an owner for each ask and a target timeline? Ideally we'd close this by EOW so procurement can complete the PO.

Also attaching the redline for reference.

Best,
Marco
Senior Procurement Manager | Aurelia Health

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + routing evidence for EU processing

Marco — thanks for the clear ask and the redline.

Quick plan from our side:
- Kimberly will own the DPA redline response and provide a short memo calling out the UK addendum/IDTA applicability. Target: Tue 2026-05-04 EOD.
- Laura will run the TIA mapping and provide a one-page matrix showing where traffic exits/ingresses and which safeguards apply. Target: Wed 2026-05-05 midday.
- I'll assemble a compact evidence bundle (SOC2 excerpt, subprocessor inventory, and the TIA matrix) and surface any exceptions. Target: Wed 2026-05-05 EOD.

Attaching a working subprocessor CSV and a draft TIA mapping (placeholders) — we'll update after Laura's run.

If Aurelia needs a signoff from legal before Wed EOD, let us know and we can prioritize the memo.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + routing evidence for EU processing

Marco — attaching our DPA response (redline comments) inline in the document. Short summary below:

- UK addendum: Our platform supports UK Addendum/IDTA where customers select UK residency. We treat the addendum as applicable only when the customer elects UK residency or explicitly requests UK-only processing. We will sign the addendum; redline explains limited carveouts for on-prem integrations.
- Subprocessors: provided a tiered inventory; the CSV lists primary GPU hosts, metrics/observability providers, and an analytics vendor. All processors performing persistent storage of EU customer content are listed and we provide subprocessors' country locations.
- TIA scope: we cannot enumerate ephemeral network hops for hosted cloud providers beyond what providers disclose, but we include contractual routing commitments and fallback behavior.

If Aurelia legal has proposed alternative language, please highlight the clauses and we can propose compromise wording.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Infrastructure Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@aureliahealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + routing evidence for EU processing

Thanks Kimberly — that helps. A couple of follow-ups from legal:

1) They want explicit confirmation that when a UK residency contract is executed, the UK addendum controls (not the EU SCCs) for UK data subjects.
2) On subprocessors, they requested a short attestation that subprocessor access is limited to "processing for Redwood's inference service" and that subcontractors will not reprocess or sell data.
3) For the TIA matrix, they asked if Redwood can mark any subprocessor that performs tokenization/pseudonymization in-country (we see two vendors flagged in the CSV but want formal confirmation).

Can we get succinct yes/no + 1-2 sentence supporting language for each of these? Procurement needs the bundle by Wed to finalize PO.

Marco

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + routing evidence for EU processing

Hi Marco — concise responses below (for legal / procurement bundle):

1) UK residency: Yes. When the customer signs the UK residency amendment, the UK Addendum/IDTA governs UK personal data processing and takes precedence for UK data subjects; the DPA will include a clause to that effect.

2) Subprocessor attestation: Yes. Attestation: "Redwood Inference confirms that each listed subprocessor is engaged solely to provide services necessary for the operation of Redwood's inference service and is contractually prohibited from using, selling, or reprocessing customer data for independent purposes." We will add standard audit rights and termination-on-breach clauses in the DPA redline.

3) Tokenization/pseudonymization: We confirm two subcontractors (TokenizeCo and EU-Pseudonym Ltd) perform pseudonymization services in-country. We have updated the CSV to flag both and included location columns.

I've uploaded the final TIA matrix and the updated subprocessor inventory to the shared link (DocuSign-ready bundle). Let us know if you'd like a 20-min call to walk through it.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Privacy Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@aureliahealth.com>

- Expect a DocuSign envelope for the DPA + UK addendum tomorrow morning.
- If anything material changes in the redline post-signature, Aurelia will request a post-signature remediation plan; otherwise we proceed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. If you can share the signed DocuSign link when available, that'd be great.

Best,
Marco
